question: If the magnification of an image from a spherical mirror is -1.38, then the nature of the image will be:
solution:
The correct answer is** real, inverted and enlarged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Magnification of a mirror** or a lens is the **ratio** of the** size of the image**
